title: After 10th: what next?
sub: Every option and where it leads

scenes.say: Just finished Class 10? Choosing what to study next is a big decision. Here are all your options, and where each one leads.

items: Leads to B.Tech, B.Sc, B.Arch, NDA
scenes.say: Intermediate M P C, with maths, physics and chemistry, leads to engineering, B Sc, architecture and the N D A. Key exams are JEE Main, EAPCET and N D A.

items: Leads to MBBS, BDS, Pharmacy, Nursing, Agriculture
scenes.say: Bi P C, with biology, physics and chemistry, leads to medicine, dentistry, pharmacy, nursing and agriculture. The key exams are NEET UG and EAPCET.

items: Leads to B.Com, BBA, CA, CMA, CS
scenes.say: M E C and C E C are commerce streams. They lead to B Com, B B A, and professional courses like C A, C M A and C S.
H E C, with history, economics and civics, leads to B A, five year law, and social work. It's a strong base for civil services, law, journalism and teaching.

items: Then jobs, or B.Tech from 2nd year (ECET)
scenes.say: A polytechnic diploma takes three years. You join through POLYCET. After it, you can work as a technician or junior engineer, or join B Tech directly in the second year through E CET.
I T I trade courses take one to two years, in trades like electrician, fitter, mechanic and welder. They lead to apprenticeships and quick jobs.
To choose, think about which subjects you enjoy and what career you want. Talk to your parents and teachers, and check entrance exam dates early.
On Marg Disha dot com, open What next, pick Class 10, and see every option with its duration, careers and entrance exams.
Everything is free on Marg Disha dot com, in English, Telugu and Hindi. Subscribe for more guides like this.
